player_prompt.intro:
Akwaaba Lights Out! Wɔde {size}x{size} grid of lights ama wo.
Wo botae ne sɛ wobɛma dɔn nyinaa NKOGUO (kyerɛw 'nkyerɛmu' no '.')
Berɛ a wɔbɛpɛ dɔn bi, ɛno ankasa ne ne nɔrepɛn (soro/ase/benkum/nifa) no bɛdan.
Kyerɛw [row col] sɛ wopɛ dɔn bi (0-indexed, enti berɛmo koraa ne 0-{max_index}).
Wo wɔ {max_turns} nhyehyeɛ sɛ wobɛtumi ato botae no.
Nsɛm: 'O' = dɔn YƐ, '.' = dɔn NKOGUO
